paragraphs.text: Regis is a dog familiar belonging to Jinnie Fay , a prominent member of the Cabaretti family in New Capenna . He is depicted as a large, noble beast, whose presence is both imposing and comforting. Regis's demeanor is calm and attentive, reflecting his role as a loyal companion and protector to Jinnie. His has a majestic and powerful appearance, often lying by Jinnie's side and responding to her movements with a serene and dignified air.

In the Vantoleone, Regis was in Jetmir 's office alongside Jinnie Fay and Muri , her cat . While Jinnie conversed with Jetmir about the upcoming Crescendo event, Regis lay with his head resting on his paws, showing his relaxed yet alert nature. When Jinnie prepared to leave the office, Regis rose and mirrored her actions, demonstrating his readiness to follow and protect her. This scene illustrated Regis's role as a constant and steadfast presence in Jinnie's life, providing both companionship and security as she navigated the complex social and political landscape of New Capenna​.
